task: Making microwave egg and smoked salmon bowl
query: How do I make a microwave egg and smoked salmon bowl?

goal.title: Microwave eggs with pink fish pieces
goal.description: Crack and beat one egg, add seasonings and pink fish-like pieces, microwave in repeated short cycles with stirring between them, then plate the curds and garnish with chopped green onion.
goal.final_state: A white plate holds set egg curds containing pink pieces and topped with green onion. The plate is held up with the fork resting on it; no eating or temperature verification is visible.

procedure.description: Open cupboard doors, retrieve a pink-rimmed bowl, close the doors and set the bowl beside the cutting board.

Open the egg carton and retrieve one egg. Transfer it to the left hand, tap the shell repeatedly with a fork, pry the shell apart and empty the yolk and white into the bowl. Place the shell in the carton, retrieve the fork and beat the egg.

Open a blue salt container and shake it over the bowl. Open the small pepper jar, tilt and tap it over the egg and put it down. Beat the seasoned egg, reposition the board and bowl, add several pinches of the pink fish-like pieces, then stir them into the egg.

Set the fork down and carry the bowl to the microwave. Open the door, place the bowl on the turntable, close it and select cooking controls including PL5. Wait briefly, stop the running microwave, open it and retrieve the bowl. Close the door, return to the counter and stir the still-fluid mixture.

Rest the fork, reopen the microwave and replace the bowl. Close the door, enter 15 seconds and PL5, and wait for the countdown to reach End. Remove the bowl and stir the partly set egg with the fork, then change grip for another return to the microwave.

Return the bowl, close the microwave, select 15 seconds and PL5 again, and wait for End. Open the door, lift out the bowl with the left hand and stir the increasingly firm curds with the right-hand fork. Lower the fork and bring the bowl back toward the open microwave.

Place the bowl inside for a fourth cycle, close the door, set another 15 seconds at PL5 and wait. Open the microwave, retrieve the bowl, lower it to the counter, take the fork and break up the visibly set egg curds.

Set the fork down, approach the open dishwasher, pull its rack and retrieve a white plate. Carry it to the counter, lift the mixing bowl and scrape the cooked curds onto the plate with the fork. Set the bowl aside, sprinkle several pinches of chopped green onion, retrieve the fork, lift the plate and display the garnished eggs. A small forkful is lifted but eating is not visible.

coarse.goal_contribution: Combines the visible seasonings and pink pieces with the egg before heating.
coarse.predictability_reason: The beaten egg needs fish pieces for the stated dish.

coarse.instruction: Microwave briefly and stir the egg mixture

coarse.predictability_reason: The seasoned egg and fish mixture is ready to microwave.

coarse.instruction: Heat and stir the egg mixture again
coarse.description: Rest the fork, reopen and reload the microwave, close it, select 15 seconds at PL5, wait for End, retrieve the bowl and stir.
coarse.goal_contribution: Advances cooking and mixes the partly set contents before further heating.
coarse.predictability_reason: After the brief microwave cycle and stir, further heating is a natural continuation.

coarse.instruction: Heat and stir the forming egg curds
coarse.description: Replace the bowl, close and program another 15-second PL5 cycle, wait, open the door, retrieve the bowl and stir the thickening mixture.
coarse.goal_contribution: Further sets the egg and separates the forming curds.
coarse.predictability_reason: The egg mixture remains in repeated heat-and-stir cooking.

coarse.instruction: Finish heating and break up the egg curds

coarse.goal_contribution: Produces visibly firm curds that can be transferred to a serving plate.
coarse.predictability_reason: The forming curds naturally need a final heating and stir.
